messages:
anna: CI job `publish-image` is failing intermittently after my Dockerfile tweak (small chmod change). Canaries are red, looks like registry upload errors. Anyone around to triage?

matt: which error? 401 or manifest mismatch?

anna: both, depending on retry. Pasting last chunk of the push log:```
time="2026-03-15T14:22:11Z" level=error msg="upload failed" status=401 response="Unauthorized"
PUT https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/org/service/blobs/uploads/uuid?digest=sha256:abc... - 401
--- retry ---
PUT https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/org/service/blobs/uploads/uuid?digest=sha256:abc... - 201
PATCH https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/org/service/blobs/uploads/uuid - 412 Precondition Failed: invalid chunk size
```

sam: two signals there: intermittent auth (401) + a 412 on finalize which is usually client/transfer mismatch (chunked vs content-length). Did the runner VM just update docker/kaniko?

lina: I saw an upgrade on the self-hosted runners yesterday (docker 24.0.3 -> 24.1.0). Might affect chunked uploads. Local kaniko push from my laptop succeeded though.

anna: it only fails in CI runners, local and dev cluster are fine. Could be network/proxy rewriting content-length.

devops-bot: rerun requested by @anna - build #4587 queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt: while that reruns, can you curl the registry endpoint from a failing runner to see headers? `curl -v https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/` and also check for `X-Forwarded-Proto`/`Content-Length` differences.

anna: curl output from the runner:```
* Connected to registry.redwood.ai (10.1.2.3) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v2/ HTTP/1.1
> Host: registry.redwood.ai
> User-Agent: curl/7.88.1
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Server: registry/2.7.3
< X-Request-Id: 0a1b2c3d
< X-Registry-Version: 2.7.3
< Via: squid-cache.example.com
```

sam: ah - there is a reverse proxy (squid) in the path. Squid has a history of mangling chunked uploads unless configured. Can we check the proxy logs for 412s?

lina: proxy team confirmed a config push yesterday to the edge squad but said they didn't touch chunked rules. I'll ping them. @edge-team?

matt: short-term workaround: 1) disable chunked uploads in the build (force content-length) or 2) switch CI to push to staging registry that bypasses the proxy. Which is quicker?

anna: staging push works, I pushed a temporary tag to staging to unblock the release. But we need a CI fix. Rerun of the failing job just finished and still hit the same 401 -> 412 sequence.

sam: can you add a retry around the finalization step? If you see 412, try re-uploading the blob from the start (most registries accept reupload). Also add exponential backoff on 401s for 60s total. Easy to patch in the publish script.

anna: putting a small retry wrapper in publishing script now and kicking a canary. Will report back.

matt: also please file a bisect request: bisect between last-green commit `9a1b2c` and HEAD, but given the proxy and runner docker upgrade noise, might be infra+client combo. If someone from infra can rerun older runner image (pre-upgrade) that'd help.

lina: filing INC-2379 to track registry/proxy troubleshooting and will loop in edge/proxy. I'll include collected headers and sample request IDs from the logs.

anna: thanks. Quick status: temporary unblock via staging, patching publish script with retries. Will tag this thread when the canary with retries passes.

devops-bot: build #4589 succeeded (staging push) - triggered by @anna :white_check_mark:

sam: great. I can run a bisect tomorrow if needed. For now, let's keep the retry + staging fallback.

anna: appreciated everyone. Leaving the issue open (INC-2379) and setting priority P2. Will update if we confirm root cause. :slightly_smiling_face:
